Safe Home Away From Home

Separate Residential Boarding for Boys & Girls

Mount Carmel School provides a disciplined, warm, and family-like residential boarding environment for students from across Darjeeling, Siliguri, Dooars, Sikkim, Bihar, and Northeast India.

🍲 Nutritious Dining

Hygienic kitchen serving balanced breakfast, lunch, evening snacks, and dinner (vegetarian & non-vegetarian options) with clean RO drinking water.

📚 Evening Supervised Prep

Daily structured morning and evening study hours supervised by resident teachers and wardens for doubt-clearing and homework completion.

🛡️ 24/7 Security & Wardens

Separate, gated Boys' and Girls' hostel wings with dedicated resident wardens, pucca boundary walls, and round-the-clock pastoral care.

⚕️ Medical Tie-Ups & Care

On-campus first-aid infirmary, periodic health checkups, and rapid emergency medical tie-ups with nearby Bagdogra and Siliguri hospitals.

Updated Apps Script (Bound to Sheet 1TKk1Yu4ewUTzhjASH683bwdgr6IpZtzS_A4NIKJ2ewA): 
const SHEET_ID = "1TKk1Yu4ewUTzhjASH683bwdgr6IpZtzS_A4NIKJ2ewA";

function doPost(e) {
  try {
    var ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(SHEET_ID);
    var sheet = ss.getSheetByName("Sheet1") || ss.getSheets()[0];
    var data = {};
    if (e.postData && e.postData.contents) {
      try { data = JSON.parse(e.postData.contents); } catch (err) {}
    }
    if (e.parameter && Object.keys(e.parameter).length > 0) {
      for (var k in e.parameter) { if (!data[k]) data[k] = e.parameter[k]; }
    }
    sheet.appendRow([
      new Date(),
      data.type || "Admission Enquiry",
      data.name || "",
      data.phone || "",
      data.gradeOrBatch || "",
      data.details || "",
      data.email || "",
      data.parentOrHouse || "",
      data.residenceOrProfession || "",
      data.localityOrCity || "",
      data.status || "New"
    ]);
    return ContentService.createTextOutput(JSON.stringify({ status: "ok" }))
      .setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JSON);
  } catch (err) {
    return ContentService.createTextOutput(JSON.stringify({ status: "error", message: err.toString() }))
      .setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JSON);
  }
}

function doGet(e) {
  if (e && e.parameter && e.parameter.action === "append") {
    return doPost(e);
  }
  return ContentService.createTextOutput(JSON.stringify({ status: "ready", sheetId: SHEET_ID }))
    .setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JSON);
}
